name: Squeeze, momentum, and trend combo (1h)
rationale: Combines the three volatility/trend reads that each have edge alone: a prior bandwidth squeeze (compressed energy), a positive medium return (momentum), and a strong ADX (trend confirmed). On 1h this catches a coiled range releasing into a confirmed directional move — the full life-cycle of a breakout in one signal. The other side is the range-scalper positioned for continued compression. Edge persists because the compression-plus-momentum-plus-trend conjunction marks genuine regime transitions, not noise. Distinct from the two-legged squeeze specs by requiring momentum as well. Disconfirmer: exits when ADX falls under the exit floor (the breakout fizzled) or the stop fires.
catalyst: squeeze releasing into a confirmed momentum trend
